title: UI site report
description: What happened to each component of one site when ui-clone went through it into victor-ui: registry items in the registry's order, then catalog pages no item covers.

site.description: The sites.json key, or the URL's host when the site has no entry.

into.description: Absolute path of the victor-ui repo.

target.description: The score that ends each rebuild.

dryRun.description: True when nothing was written and no model was called.

name.description: The registry item's name, or the page's last path segment.

itemUrl.description: The registry item URL. Null for a page no registry item covers.

pageUrl.description: The component's page, from the catalog or the site's page template. Null when the site has neither.

outcome.description: kept: code written into victor-ui, or would be on a dry run. exists: victor-ui already has an item from this itemUrl or pageUrl. rebuilt: the best round reached the target. below-target: the best round did not. would-rebuild: a dry run would rebuild it. no-steps: the survey, ui-steps, or both tries at recording with its steps failed. rebuild-failed: the rebuild loop judged no round or stopped with an error. needs-terms: no written terms allow keeping code from this site. skipped: not a component type, nothing to rebuild from, or not tried after the site answered 429 or a bot check. failed: any other error, or the 429 or bot check that stopped the site.

detail.description: What add.mjs printed, why it is locked or skipped, the rebuild's name and best round, or the error code and message.

score.description: The rebuild's best score. Null when nothing was judged.

costUsd.description: Model spend on this component: ui-steps plus the rebuild's ui-draft rounds.

stepsFile.description: The page-record steps file ui-steps wrote, in the data home. Null when none was written.

costUsd.description: The sum of every item's costUsd.
